title: Redraw
summary: REDRAW', verb transitive [re and draw.] 1. To draw again. In commerce, to draw a new bill of exchange, as the holder of a protested bill, on the drawer or indorsers. 2. To draw a second draft or copy.

inlines.v: REDRAW', verb transitive [re and draw.] 1. To draw again. In commerce, to draw a new bill of exchange, as the holder of a protested bill, on the drawer or indorsers. 2. To draw a second draft or copy.
